papers.title: Electrophoretic Deposition of Green-Synthesized Hydroxyapatite on Thermally Oxidized Titanium: Enhanced Bioactivity and Antibacterial Performance
papers.abstract: Titanium alloys such as Ti-6Al-4V are widely used in biomedical implants due to their excellent mechanical properties and biocompatibility, but their bioinert nature limits osseointegration and antibacterial performance. This study proposes a multifunctional surface coating system integrating a thermally oxidized TiO2 interlayer with a hydroxyapatite (HAp) top layer synthesized via a green route using Hylocereus undatus extract. The HAp was deposited by electrophoretic deposition (EPD), enabling continuous coverage and strong adhesion to the pre-treated Ti-6Al-4V substrate. Structural, morphological, chemical, and electrical characterizations were performed using XRD, SEM, EDS, Raman spectroscopy, and impedance spectroscopy. Bioactivity was assessed through apatite formation in simulated body fluid (SBF), while antibacterial properties were evaluated against Staphylococcus aureus. The results demonstrated successful formation of crystalline TiO2 (rutile phase) and calcium-rich HAp with good surface coverage. The HAp-coated surfaces exhibited significantly enhanced bioactivity and strong antibacterial performance, likely due to the combined effects of surface roughness and the bioactive compounds present in the plant extract. This study highlights the potential of eco-friendly, bio-inspired surface engineering to improve the biological performance of titanium-based implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注生物活性和抗菌性能，而非力学性能（疲劳、拉伸等），与用户关注的后处理对Ti-6Al-4V力学性能影响的方向不符。
llm.why_not_core: Paper does not evaluate any mechanical properties (fatigue, tensile, porosity closure) nor does it examine post-processing effects on mechanical performance of Ti-6Al-4V; it solely focuses on bioactivity and antibacterial performance of a surface coating.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高钛合金植入物的生物活性和抗菌性能
summary_zh.method: 通过火龙果提取物绿色合成羟基磷灰石，并用电泳沉积法涂覆在热氧化处理的钛合金表面
summary_zh.result: 涂层表面形成良好，显著增强生物活性和抗菌性能
summary_zh.validation: 模拟体液浸泡和金黄色葡萄球菌抗菌测试

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the bioactivity and antibacterial performance of Ti-6Al-4V implants through a multifunctional coating.
summary_en.method: A green-synthesized hydroxyapatite was deposited via electrophoretic deposition onto a thermally oxidized TiO2 interlayer on Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The coated surfaces showed enhanced apatite formation in SBF and strong antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus.
summary_en.validation: Bioactivity was assessed by apatite formation in simulated body fluid, and antibacterial efficacy by disk diffusion against S. aureus.
